artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He faces slightly left while looking directly at the viewer. He has a youthful face with soft features, full cheeks, and fair complexion. His hair is wavy, cascading to his shoulders. He wears a dark, buttoned garment with a wide white collar. The ornate oval frame is decorated with a laurel wreath pattern. The background is dark and there is text in a banner around the frame and at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a portrait. He is facing slightly to his left, looking towards the viewer. He has a serene expression with slightly arched eyebrows and curly, shoulder-length hair. The man is wearing dark formal attire with a wide, white collar. The background is plain, and the portrait is set within an oval frame with intricate patterns and text. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the portrait.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man. He is positioned slightly facing the viewer's left and has long, thick, curly hair framing his face. His facial features include a composed expression with his eyes gazing towards the viewer, a straight nose, and closed lips. He is dressed in ornate clothing with a richly patterned collar, elaborate embroidery, and elegant fabric. There is an embroidered star visible on the right side of his chest. There are no visible accessories or objects held in his hands. The background of the image is an oval frame with text encircling it, and there are decorative crowns and letters in the corners outside the frame.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of a man facing the viewer's left side. The man has long, curly hair, a prominent nose, full lips, and dark eyes. He is wearing a garment with a richly embroidered lace collar covering his shoulders and chest. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is an oval frame against a light, textured space, with no additional details.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The portrait shows the upper body of a man turned slightly to his left, facing the viewer with a calm expression. He has long, wavy hair that extends past his shoulders and a neatly groomed mustache and beard. His facial features are refined, with arched eyebrows and a moderately pointed nose. He is clothed in a dark, draped garment with a prominent white collar. Surrounding him is an intricately designed oval frame with inscriptions, and below the frame is an ornate crest featuring a serpent and a crown. The background consists of fine lines that create a textured, neutral backdrop, enhancing the prominence of the subject within the oval frame.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Colbert
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to his left while looking directly at the viewer. He has shoulder-length, wavy hair, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a straight nose. He is dressed in a historical garment with a dark robe and a white collar. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with an engraved inscription, and at the bottom is a crest with a decorative design. The background features a detailed textured pattern.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Coislin
artworks.description: This print shows a man from the waist up. He is turned slightly to the left, looking out at us with a neutral expression. The man has a high forehead, a long nose, and a small mustache. His hair is wavy and falls around his chin. He wears a formal garment with a large collar and buttons down the front. There is a circular frame around the portrait with an inscription along its border and a coat of arms below. The background of the print has a fine, crosshatched pattern.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Coislin
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing slightly to his right but looking directly at the viewer. He has a calm expression with a prominent nose and thin lips. His hair is medium length, dark, and wavy, framing his face and extending to his shoulders. He is dressed in dark formal attire with a wide white collar and a pendant or brooch at his neck. The background features an oval frame with striped patterns and an ornate crest or coat of arms below it.

artworks.title: Francois de Clermont Tonnerre
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up. The man faces forward with his body slightly turned to the right. He has a delicate face with a slightly pointed chin, a straight nose, and a subtle smile. He has medium-length curly hair framing his face. He wears a historical garment with a wide collar and a dark buttoned jacket. The clothing appears to be from an earlier era, possibly the 17th century. Surrounding him is an oval decorative border with intricate detailing. Below the border is a shield with two crossed keys and a crown-like ornament. The background has fine horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Leon-Bouthillier, Comte de Chavigny
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He is facing the viewer, slightly turned to his right. He has pronounced facial features, curly shoulder-length hair, and is wearing a textured coat with a white collar, a sash, and a star on his shoulder. The background features an oval frame with intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man in traditional portrait style. The man is depicted in upper body view, facing slightly to the right. He appears to be smiling slightly, with defined cheekbones, a mustache, and a chin beard. His shoulder-length wavy hair is parted in the middle. He is dressed in formal attire with a wide collar, ornate robe, and a badge or medallion on a sash across his chest. The background features an intricate frame with a wreath encircling his face, crowned monograms, floral and scroll motifs, and a heraldic design at the bottom.

artworks.title: Charles, Duc de Chaulnes
artworks.description: The image depicts the bust of a man facing forward, with his body shown from the chest up. He has a broad face with a firm chin, prominent nose, and somewhat pursed lips. His hair is long, curly, and dark, cascading down his shoulders. He is dressed in aristocratic attire, including a large lace cravat and armor with visible pauldrons. The portrait is set within an oval frame with engraved text surrounding it. The background has textured lines.

artworks.title: Antoine de Chaubard
artworks.description: The image is a bust portrait of a man. The man faces slightly to the left, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has long, slightly wavy hair that falls to his shoulders, along with a mustache and a small pointed beard. He has serious-looking eyes, a long nose, and a slightly curved mouth. He wears traditional clothing, including a high-collared garment with buttons and a cravat or bow tied at the neck. The portrait is bordered by an oval frame and rests upon a decorative element at the bottom with a coat of arms. The background of the image is filled with fine, intricate hatch lines, creating a textured effect within the oval boundary.

artworks.title: Jean Chapelain
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a bust-length portrait of a man within an oval frame. The man is positioned facing slightly to his left while looking towards the viewer. His facial features include a long, narrow face with prominent cheekbones, a sharp nose, and full lips. His hair is long, reaching past his shoulders, and is wavy and parted in the middle. He wears a dark garment with a high collar, possibly a cloak, that is draped over his shoulders, along with a lace cravat at his neck. The frame around him is elaborate, with text encircling the inner edge of the oval. Below the oval is a depiction of a small cherub and a decorative band. The background within the oval is dark and textured, creating a contrast with the man's lighter complexion, while outside the oval, a lined pattern fills the space.

artworks.title: Guy Chamillard
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his right, with curly, shoulder-length hair framing his face. His features include a prominent nose, high forehead, and a somewhat serious expression. He wears a dark garment with a white lace collar. Surrounding him is an oval frame with Latin text around it, and below the oval is a decorative emblem or coat of arms. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Marechal de Castelnau
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a long face, a prominent nose, thin lips, and curly hair flowing over his shoulders and chest. He faces slightly left but looks at the viewer. He wears a large collar and an ornate garment, possibly ceremonial or military, with a breastplate. The portrait is in an oval frame with a crest at the bottom, and the background has textured lines around the man's head. Below the image is text in a decorative script within a rectangular panel.

artworks.title: Jean-Frederic, Duc de Brunswick-Lunebourg (Hanover)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-torso portrait of a man positioned facing forward. He has a round face with prominent, heavy-lidded eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. His hair is long, thick, and curly, cascading down past his shoulders. He is wearing an ornate garment with a decorative shoulder cover that features a large, detailed face embellishment. Around him is an oval frame containing text. The background behind the man is plain.

artworks.title: Henri-Auguste, Comte de Brienne
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man. He is centered within an oval frame adorned with oak leaves and ribbons. He is facing slightly left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a gentle expression, a prominent nose, and long, slightly wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a dark cloak with a high collar and a white collar underneath. There is a decorative sash or ribbon diagonally across his chest, with a star-shaped insignia on his left shoulder. The background has delicate cross-hatching, contrasting with the ornamental frame. Below the portrait is a coat of arms with two lions and other heraldic elements in a symmetrical design.

artworks.title: Henri-Auguste, Comte de Brienne
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to the right but facing the observer. The man's facial features include a prominent nose, slightly puffy cheeks, and calm, focused eyes. He has long, slightly wavy hair that extends to his shoulders and wears a close-fitting cap covering the top of his head. His attire consists of a dark garment with a large, white flanged collar and a sash across his chest, along with a decorative star emblem on his shoulder. No visible jewelry or objects are being held by the person. The background presents an ornate design, with a wreath of leaves encircling the upper part of the image and flowing ribbons incorporated into the design. Below the portrait, there is a decorative crest or coat of arms featuring two lions and a detailed emblem.

artworks.title: Madame Bouthillier
artworks.description: The image shows a waist-up portrait of a woman facing the viewer. She is slightly turned to her right, has a solemn expression, and wavy hair falling around her cheeks. She wears a small cap and clothing with noticeable texture. The woman is framed in an ornate oval frame with leaf and ribbon designs. The background includes an architectural element with a heraldic shield and decorative embellishments underneath the frame.

artworks.title: Victor Bouthillier
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body facing slightly to the left with his head turned toward the viewer. The man has curly, medium-length hair, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. He is wearing religious attire, including a large collar, a robe, and a clerical cap. A cross on a chain hangs around his neck. In the background, there is an ornate frame holding the portrait, surrounded by draped fabric and various ecclesiastical symbols, such as a mitre, a cross-staff, books, and religious insignia. The setting conveys a formal and religious atmosphere, emphasizing the man's clerical authority.

artworks.title: Victor Bouthillier
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a mature face with distinct features, including a prominent nose, thin lips, and curly hair under a skullcap. He wears a clerical robe with a high collar, visible buttons, and a chain with a large cross pendant around his neck. The background is plain within an oval frame with fine lines and a decorative crest at the bottom, suggesting a formal and historical style.

artworks.title: Victor Bouthillier
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up, positioned at a slight angle facing the viewer. He has a composed expression with soft facial features, including a mustache and a small goatee. His hair is medium length, wavy, and reaches just below his ears. He is dressed in a patterned cloak over a collared garment, accessorized with a long chain bearing a large cross. The background features an elaborate frame with intricate linear designs and a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with prominent facial features, wearing a dark garment with a white collar and a large, ornate star-shaped medal. The person is facing to the right with a composed expression. The background consists of a detailed oval border with embedded text.
